question: In Hepatocellular trials where a non–PD-L1 biomarker was required, extract the biomarker name(s) from the trial name.
hidden_column: Is any other biomarker used for inclusion
pred_sql: SELECT "NCT", "Trial name" FROM clinical_trials WHERE "Cancer type" = 'Hepatocellular' AND "Is PD-L1 positivity inclusion criteria" = 'No';
